name: CF Industries

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (CF Industries New Logo.svg)

description: CF Industries makes nitrogen fertilizer and industrial nitrogen products from natural gas: ammonia, granular urea, UAN solution and ammonium nitrate (AN), plus diesel exhaust fluid and nitric acid. It runs eight plants in the US and Canada and one in the UK, and says its North American plants hold about 40% of ammonia, 41% of urea, 44% of UAN and 19% of AN capacity there. It sells to farm co-ops and dealers, industrial customers and exporters at market prices that swing with global nitrogen supply and natural gas costs, so profit moves far more than volume. It is building a low-carbon ammonia plant at Blue Point, Louisiana with Japanese partners JERA and Mitsui who will buy part of the output.

sub.name: Farm inputs: fertiliser, seeds and farm machinery
